title: The worst bank ever
body:
This bank repeatedly takes my money and fails to return it. Previously, an ATM retained 500 dirhams. I visited the branch, but the staff did not assist me and instructed me to contact the call centre instead. The call centre was also unable to resolve the issue.

Recently, I deposited 250 dirhams into an ATM, which showed that the transaction was unsuccessful, yet the machine did not return my cash. Additionally, the bank’s response time is extremely slow.

I do not understand why branch staff are unable to resolve issues in person when customers come directly to the bank. Being told to call the call centre while standing inside the branch is unacceptable. If problems cannot be handled on-site, what is the purpose of having physical bank branches at all?

title: Improve privacy
body: The app works well and has useful features, but I’m concerned about privacy. Right now, if someone knows another person’s phone number, they can see their full name in the app. This could be misused by strangers or people with bad intentions. It would be much safer if names were only partially visible, or if both users had to approve each other before full names are shown. Adding this feature would protect users and make the app feel more secure
